posts.text:
One of the best businesses to build right now: a Grok Bot for one industry.

Pick a niche like dentists and build the AI agents for them so they don’t have to figure any of it out.

The stack:

- T3 Code + Opus 5.5/Fable 5.2 to build it
- Paper to design every screen first
- Orgo to give each agent its own computer
- AgentMail for an inbox
- AgentPhone for a phone number
- Composio for every connector
- CleanShot to screenshot bugs and say “fix this”

Dentists fix teeth and you set up the agents.

Really good way to learn how to become AI native while getting paid for it too.
posts.text_zh:
现在最值得做的生意之一：为某一个行业做一款 Grok Bot。

选一个细分领域，比如牙医，帮他们把 AI agent 都搭好，让他们不用自己去琢磨。

技术栈：

- 用 T3 Code + Opus 5.5/Fable 5.2 来开发
- 先用 Paper 把每个界面设计好
- 用 Orgo 给每个 agent 配一台自己的电脑
- 用 AgentMail 做收件箱
- 用 AgentPhone 配一个电话号码
- 用 Composio 接上所有连接器
- 用 CleanShot 截下 bug 截图，然后说 “fix this”

牙医负责治牙，你负责把 agent 配好。

这是一边赚钱、一边学会成为 AI native 的好办法。

来自古巴的明信片

--sref 518315848 https://t.co/kMGAZmzzFq
